title: Implement RID-specific self-contained distribution measurements
goal: Publish and measure deterministic RID-specific self-contained Host and Web Companion distributions without release publication or implicit runtime downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: The distribution manifest binds a supported RID and self-contained deployment model.
Host and Companion publish trees contain native application hosts and are rejected when framework-dependent or RID-inconsistent.
A schema-valid report records publish/archive sizes, file counts, durations and cold start probes.
Identical inputs produce byte-identical archives and the current-RID Host starts without invoking the machine dotnet command.
No release, install, workflow, approved-test or remote state changes occur.
risks: RID runtime packs may be unavailable offline.
Self-contained output may be mistaken for a fully bundled zero-prerequisite product.
Publish paths or timestamps may make archives nondeterministic.
decisions: Measure before considering trimming, single-file or ReadyToRun.
Do not modify protected package certification or approved-test paths in this checkpoint.
